Name: bezajel's Seasonal Krobus
Author: bezajel
Description:
Krobus has noticed the humans change their appearance depending on the coldness and brightness outside, and each human has a unique appearance according to their interests. In imitation of the humans, Krobus decides to take on the world of seasonal fashion, and express himself as only he can.


[b]Features:
[/b]
[list]
[*]8 new outfits (2 per season)
[*]2 bonus alternative portraits
[*]'Morph' option appearances change with emotions
[*]Config options including randomisation
[/list]

[b]Installation:
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Unzip
[*]Place in your mods folder
[/list]

[b]Configuration:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Enable / Disable mod
[/list][list]
[*]Outfit Style:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿﻿'Adorn' - ﻿wears items on a headband.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿'Morph' - changes appearance by shapeshifting.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿'Random' - either style will be selected randomly each day.

[list]
[*]Seasonal Settings:
[/list] ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿'Daily' - wears his seasonal appearance every day.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿'Festivals' - changes appearance only on festival days.

[b]Note[/b]: 'Festivals' setting does not force him to attend festivals, he simply acknowledges festivals by dressing up on festival days.

[b]Note[/b]: Alt versions of his 'Morph' Spring and Fall outfits are included in the files, but are not implemented in the code. If you prefer the alt version you will need to change its file name to be the main version.


[b]Compatibility:
[/b]
This mod can be turned off in the config, so will not conflict with other mods simply by being loaded.

You will need to disable Krobus in other mods such as Seasonal Cute.

Downloads.Description: Unzip and place in your Mods folder.
